title: Clinical Influence of Different Surface Treatments on Implant Stabiity
official: Clinical Influence of Different Surface Treatments on Implant Stabiity: a Prospective Observational Clinical Study
summary: The goal of this observational study is to monitor, within a cohort of patients requiring rehabilitation at two different sites in the premolar area, the primary and secondary stability of implants placed with different surface treatments: vacuum-plasma activation, ozonated oil and non-activated implants.
